requirement_contract_patches.REQ-CLIP-VIEW-001: Clip double-click in Session/Arrangement, Selector, Toggle or Ctrl+Alt+3 Win/Cmd+Option+3 Mac opens Clip View. Toggle while Device View is open stacks Clip View above it. Dragging top border resizes; bottom closes it. In Session, a Track Status Display click opens the Clip View for that track’s currently playing clip; require independently established playing status, not a stopped/empty/group/monitored interpretation. Session owns the status presentation.
requirement_contract_patches.REQ-CLIP-VIEW-004: Clip Rename and Edit Info Text are available through specified title/Edit/clip menus. Audio clip rename does not rename source sample. Multi-selection shows count; common new name is not displayed as title. The source reference-name default is retained only for independently admitted creation/reference history; saved defaults, imports, filename grammar and target initial state remain U.
requirement_contract_patches.REQ-CLIP-VIEW-005: The source describes new clips using track color, but Q031 keeps matched Clip Color preference/version/creation history unresolved; no unconditional inheritance or random-color law is chosen. Title and clip-context palettes change clip color. Track Assign Color commands affect clips only in the invoking Session or Arrangement view. Group Assign behavior and its existing active-view/member/nonmember case remain REQ-MIXING-WORKFLOW-012/MXW-012, not a new Clip View law or duplicated test. Multi-selection title is striped while individual selected clips accept color.
requirement_contract_patches.REQ-CLIP-VIEW-021: When a long reversal exposes progress, the source names Status Bar progress and temporary action lock while already playing clips continue. Newly observed waveform generation is the documented eligibility context for reversed-clip playback and other actions. Revert/reverse and close/reopen histories remain separate; source speed/cache prose is not a deadline, universal glitch-free promise or internal cache architecture requirement.
requirement_contract_patches.REQ-CLIP-VIEW-031: Selector overview spans clip Start-End; its outline represents the visible editor portion. Within-outline horizontal/vertical drags provide scrolling/zooming roles. Follow is offered by its toggle and Options command. With a genuinely established automatically scrolling playhead baseline, an actual Sample/MIDI editor edit pauses Follow. The source names stop, restart, Arrangement scrub and clip scrub as resumption contexts; this does not promise moving scrolling while stopped, a deadline or universal focus/interception behavior. MIDI-specific editing remains with its owner.
requirement_contract_patches.REQ-CLIP-VIEW-045: Clip Update Rate in Record/Warp/Launch settings quantizes changes to a running clip. Launch Mode/Warp Mode can be defaults for new clips. Complete affected-control set, rate choices and precedence versus global launch quantization are U. Global new-clip Launch Mode/Warp Mode defaults are distinct from sample-specific Save Default Clip and require admitted type/view/history: no MIDI audio-Warp or Arrangement Session-launch constructor is inferred.

new_requirements.contract: In an independently admitted audio-loop context, Edit offers Duplicate Loop as a command entry. The chapter describes loop-length/content duplication generally; no audio content-copy, generated length/identity, timing, waveform or file-operation oracle is supplied here. Existing REQ-MIDI-EDIT-019/MED-019 owns its explicit MIDI duplicate/outside-note relationship.
